pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibiting sub-polygonal geometry with soft, smooth pixel gradients at the edges, likely intensified by optical blur. The relative spatial area of patches is inconsistent across the visible flank section.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Negative-space topological graph characterized by light pelage. Junction nodes are identifiable where 3-4 pathways meet. Pixel thickness is variable and continuity is frequently broken by high-frequency foreground noise from foliage.
